connected: Connected. Two steps left in Teams.
endpointBody: In the Developer Portal, open your bot, then Configure, and paste this as the endpoint address.
loadError: Could not load the Teams app.
noUpload: No Upload an app option? Ask your Teams admin to allow custom apps.
pasteBody: We check them with Microsoft, then keep the secret masked.
registerBody: In the Teams Developer Portal, open Tools, then Bot management, and select New bot.
secretBody: On the bot's Client secrets page, add a client secret and copy its value. The app ID is on the bot page.
tenantBody: It is on the Overview page of the Microsoft Entra admin center.
upload: In Teams, open Apps, then Manage your apps, then Upload an app, and choose the downloaded file.
